rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something changes over time or is not constant.

example.english: The price of this fruit will vary with the season.
example.traditional: 呢款水果嘅價錢會隨住季節變。
example.jyutping: nei1 fun2 seoi2 gwo2 ge3 gaa3 cin4 wui5 ceoi4 zyu6 gwai3 zit3 bin3

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately changes or alters something, including changing it to introduce variety.

example.english: You can vary the recipe to make the flavour different.
example.traditional: 你可以改下食譜，等個味道唔同啲。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 goi2 haa5 sik6 pou2 dang2 go3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4 di1

rows.note: Use this when comparing things and saying that they differ from one another.

example.english: The two versions vary from each other.
example.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 go3 baan2 bun2 jau5 fan1 bit6
